title: ITVX / Device-scale promotion
slide_intent: Check how expressive programme typography and imagery work at different display sizes, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A laptop, phone and tablet display programme-led compositions on a yellow field. The laptop carries large italic serif LIES over footage.
practical_value: Check how expressive programme typography and imagery work at different display sizes.
